## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Chicago, United States. It starts at 177 North State Street.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> This large-scale interactive torture museum highlights the terrible history of punishments, tortures and executions from humanity’s dark history.
>
> The exhibition covers 6,000 square feet and contains hundreds of examples of torture, interrogation, restraint and execution devices, plus wax sculptures depicting executioners and victims in their bloody action.
>
> An audioguide comes included, so nothing is left to the imagination.
>
> Visitors will get to fill the chilling Ghost Hunting Experience using the Ghost Hunting app.
